rationale: Original FEBS 2025 Posters supplement 15(S2):67–527, DOI 10.1002/2211-5463.70071, accessible through Salford repository PDF web rendering; full-text search finds neither kefir nor fatigue. No individual kefir Parkinson fatigue comparison identified.

Gates et al. 2022 original review pp.778–779 discusses kefir and Crohn biomarkers, fly climbing and Alzheimer cognition; introduction mentions fatigue as medication adverse effect. No plain kefir comparison for fatigue in Parkinson disease.
